topics.title: Legion of the Damned: What the New Models Mean for Lore and Rules
topics.what_is_driving_it: New Legion of the Damned models have been revealed, and fans are speculating about their lore role and likely tabletop rules, with GW also reportedly publishing Legion of the Damned rules news.
topics.relevance_note: The Auspex Tactics video is pulling about 7.7k views per day with 220 comments, and the Spikey Bits roundup flags the rules news. Covering both the model reveal and the rules speculation in one piece catches two search audiences at once.
topics.gap_note: Coverage so far splits into lore-only or rules-only videos. A piece that connects the fluff of the Damned to how their rules could play out on the table would fill that gap.

topics.title: Contrast Paints Being Axed as Warhammer Tone Pro Arrives
topics.what_is_driving_it: Reports say GW is discontinuing around 25 Contrast paints as the new Warhammer Tone Pro range launches, alongside official Tone Pro articles and painter interviews.
topics.relevance_note: Painters will want to know what to buy before stock disappears, and the official launch content gives this topic current momentum from several angles.
topics.gap_note: Official content is interviews and launch articles. Hands-on comparisons of Contrast versus Tone Pro on the same model, showing which old paints have direct replacements, have not yet appeared in the signals.

topics.title: Magnetising Magnet Baron Custodes Kits: One Build, Every Loadout
topics.what_is_driving_it: Magnet Baron has released magnetisation kits for Custodes Pallas, Telemon, Gyrfalcon and Venatari arms, priced at $5.99, letting one model swap between loadouts.
topics.relevance_note: Magnetising is a practical, high-intent hobby topic that suits step-by-step video, and the new kits give it a current product hook.
topics.gap_note: Product announcements exist, but few tutorials show the full process on Custodes, including drilling, magnet polarity and paint-safe finishing. A full build walkthrough would own this space.

topics.title: Why Is Cato Sicarius So Hated? Primarch Fates and Heresy Lore
topics.what_is_driving_it: Majorkill's recent Primarch videos on Cato Sicarius, Mortarion's fall and the worst Primarch fate are drawing strong engagement, with Cato's video getting over 300 comments.
topics.relevance_note: Fan debate about which Primarchs were wronged is active right now, and the comment volume shows people want to argue the case.

topics.title: Why Huron Turned Against the Imperium: The Badab War Explained
topics.what_is_driving_it: Wizards and Warriors' Badab War video on Huron's turn against the Imperium is drawing about 24.8k views per day.
topics.relevance_note: Badab War is a less-covered Imperium civil conflict, and the Huron story has clear momentum with a broad audience.
topics.gap_note: Most high-view lore content focuses on Primarchs and the Heresy. Badab War and Huron get far fewer dedicated explainers, so a clear, focused breakdown could stand out.

topics.title: BCB 40k Championship GT: Dark Angels Go 5-0 Over Orks and Thousand Sons
topics.what_is_driving_it: Benjamin Frederiksen's undefeated Dark Angels list won the BCB 40k Championship GT, beating Ghazghkull's Orks and Magnus's Thousand Sons head-to-head.
topics.relevance_note: Fresh tournament results with full army lists give players immediate meta information on what is winning right now.
topics.gap_note: Results are reported as news, but few creators break down why the lists won, especially where the tie-breakers mattered. A list dissection with matchup analysis would be valuable.

topics.title: 40k Base Size Changes and Price Cut: What It Means for Your Army
topics.what_is_driving_it: The October 7 news roundup reports a GW price cut alongside the latest 40k base size updates, which affect how players mount and field their models.
topics.relevance_note: Base size questions are constant for players converting or updating armies, and this news gives the topic fresh urgency.
topics.gap_note: Base size news is usually a single line in roundups. A clear explainer covering which units are affected and whether existing models need rebasing would answer the questions people are likely asking.

topics.title: Best Airbrush Setups for Painting 40k Miniatures in 2026
topics.what_is_driving_it: Multiple Spikey Bits guides on airbrushes and compressors for miniatures are being published alongside Black Friday sales coverage.
topics.relevance_note: Buyers are actively researching equipment before the sales period, so a hands-on comparison can capture that intent.
topics.gap_note: Most results are affiliate-style listicles. Tested comparisons showing real spray results on 40k models, including noise and cleanup, would be more useful and more distinctive.

examples.cinematic_angle: Lay out the Death Guard battle-ready army in a single slow tracking shot across the table, with each model stopping for a beat on the riff. End on a close-up of a Plague Bearer's festering details as the track cuts out.

examples.name: Vengeance Is Mine
examples.cinematic_angle: A tight, fast-cut sequence showing the Night Raptor's black armour being painted and then unveiled. Cut hard on each blast-beat and end on a low-angle shot of the figure.

examples.cinematic_angle: A conversion-reveal post where the destrier is shown in dead-serious lighting, then the song kicks in and the camera pulls back to show it in a silly pose. Hold the joke for one beat and then cut to a sombre final frame.
